China, Sichuan, 14 km west southwest of Neijiang

Country and location: Tanzania, Katavi, 39 km west southwest of Mpanda
Notes: Some damage was caused in Mpanda district, where various houses collapsed. Two children were injured by a falling wall.

Albania, Durrës, 3 km west southwest of Shijak
Notes: During the 2019 Shijak earthquake, at least 108 people were injured and more than 120 buildings were damaged in the country's strongest earthquake in 30 years.

Country and location: United States, Puerto Rico, Aguadilla offshore, 67 km north northwest of San Antonio
Notes: Minor damage occurred in the western part of Puerto Rico. In Mayagüez, a water pipe broke.

Country and location: Pakistan, Azad Kashmir, 8 km south southeast of Mirpur
Notes: In the 2019 Kashmir earthquake, widespread damage was reported from the area near the epicenter. More than 6,000 houses were completely destroyed. 40 people were killed and around 850 were injured.

Country and location: Indonesia, Maluku offshore, 33 km northeast of Ambon
Notes: During the 2019 Ambon earthquake more than 6,000 buildings were damaged or destroyed, and landslides were triggered. 41 people were killed, mostly buried by landslides, and more than 1,500 were injured.

Country and location: Pakistan, Azad Kashmir, 15 km northwest of Jhelum
Notes: It was an aftershock of the 2019 Kashmir earthquake. Some additional damage was caused and 75 people were injured.

Country and location: Turkey, Tekirdağ offshore, 17 km east northeast of Marmara Ereğlisi
Notes: After the 2019 Istanbul earthquake, minor damage to buildings occurred, including a partial mosque collapse in Avcılar. One person died of a heart attack and 43 people sustained light injuries.

Country and location: Chile, Los Lagos, 30 km west southwest of Villa La Angostura, Argentina
Notes: One diver died in Puerto Montt, after a decompression problem caused by the earthquake.

Philippines, Davao offshore, 86 km south southeast of Pundaguitan
Chile, Maule offshore, 70 km west southwest of Constitución
